name: Well pump and pressure tank

comps.spec: Submersible pump, 1/2–2 hp at 230V (some 120V), lifts from 30–150 m — pulling it needs two people and a plan so the pipe isn't dropped
comps.loc: Down the well on the drop pipe

comps.spec: Above-ground jet pump, 1/2–1 hp (shallow wells, water within about 8 m)
Pressure tank with a rubber bladder, 20–120 litres
Pressure switch, about 30/50 or 40/60 psi, with heavy contacts
comps.loc: On the pipe by the tank

comps.spec: Submersible drop cable, 10–12 AWG copper, as long as the well is deep

comps.loc: Grey control box on the wall

comps.spec: Check valves, foot valve and pressure relief valve
Poly or PVC drop pipe, 25–32 mm

boards.loc: Constant-pressure controller on the wall (some newer systems)

notes: The well itself is the real prize. A submersible needs a large generator or inverter to start; once pump and pipe are out, a narrow bucket on a rope still lifts water.
